data.title: Fiber fuse effect as a mechanism of heat transfer
data.author: John Seekins
data.summary: The fiber fuse effect generates high-temperature plasma in the core of optical fibers under high-power laser radiation when initiated by local fiber heating. This plasma absorbs incident laser radiation as heat in the fiber core, which then conducts in all directions, including radially outward. Blackbody radiation is also emitted from the high-temperature region and accounts for a non-negligible proportion of heat transfer to the outer layers of the fiber. An intentionally triggered fiber fuse can act as a mechanism of heat transfer to any material into which it is embedded. A numerical simulation of the fiber fuse is developed utilizing a finite difference discretization of the axisymmetric heat equation, and an internal reradiation model is implemented to capture the effects of blackbody emission from the high-temperature region. An investigation into the effects of fiber cladding diameter on embedded material interface temperatures is conducted. Additionally, comparisons are made between results generated with and without the radiation model activated to demonstrate the importance of capturing this physics in simulating the fiber fuse effect.
data.title_cn: 纤维熔合效应作为传热机制
data.abstract_cn: 当局部光纤加热引发时，光纤熔断效应在高功率激光辐射下在光纤芯中产生高温等离子体。这种等离子体将入射激光辐射吸收为纤芯中的热量，然后向各个方向传导，包括径向向外。黑体辐射也从高温区域发出，并且在向纤维外层的热传递中占有不可忽略的比例。有意触发的纤维熔丝可以充当向其嵌入的任何材料传递热量的机制。利用轴对称热方程的有限差分离散化对光纤熔丝进行数值模拟，并采用内部再辐射模型来捕捉高温区域黑体发射的影响。研究了光纤包层直径对嵌入材料界面温度的影响。此外，还对激活和未激活辐射模型时生成的结果进行了比较，以证明在模拟光纤熔断效应时捕捉这种物理现象的重要性。

data.title: Optimizing the photothermal signal: effects of the detector position and pinhole radius in mode-mismatched Z -scan
data.author: Komna Fata, Komlan S. Gadedjisso-Tossou, Dam-Bé L. Douti, Basma Khammari, Kosi M. Novidzro, Messanh A. Mohou, Abdul Rahman, Khalid Hassan Ibnaouf, Riadh Hannachi, Humberto Cabrera
data.summary: The pump-probe mode-mismatched thermal lens Z -scan technique is used to investigate the effects of detector position (L) and pinhole radius ( ρ 0 ) on the thermal lens (TL) signal. Theoretical analysis shows that the TL signal is sensitive to both parameters, with optimal performance at a detector distance of ∼20cm and a pinhole radius of 0.02 cm. As the pinhole radius increases, the TLS peak shifts to higher L values and the signal amplitude decreases. Experimental measurements with pinhole radii of 0.02, 0.05, 0.075, and 0.1 cm, using an ethanol solution, exhibit good agreement with the theoretical model, validating its reliability. Experimental optimization validated the theoretical model, revealing the significant influence of aperture size and detector position.
data.title_cn: 优化光热信号：模式不匹配 Z 扫描中探测器位置和针孔半径的影响
data.abstract_cn: 泵浦探针模式失配热透镜Z扫描技术用于研究探测器位置(L)和针孔半径(ρ 0 )对热透镜(TL)信号的影响。理论分析表明，TL 信号对这两个参数都很敏感，在探测器距离 ∼20cm 和针孔半径 0.02 cm 时具有最佳性能。随着针孔半径的增加，TLS 峰值会移向更高的 L 值，并且信号幅度会减小。使用乙醇溶液对针孔半径为 0.02、0.05、0.075 和 0.1 cm 进行的实验测量与理论模型吻合良好，验证了其可靠性。实验优化验证了理论模型，揭示了孔径尺寸和探测器位置的显着影响。

data.title: Zero-order suppression in off-axis digital holography combining optimized non-local means filtering and a variational image decomposition model
data.author: Aoqun Liu, Hongyi Bai, Laijun Sun, Jia Chen, Suyi Men, Zhe Li
data.summary: In off-axis digital holography, phase reconstruction typically involves extracting the +1-order term spectrum, which carries the phase information of the sample. However, interference caused by the zero-order term can reduce the accuracy of this extraction. This study proposes a novel variational image decomposition model, to our knowledge, that effectively suppresses the zero-order term. An integral image is first constructed to store the cumulative sum of squared pixel differences to improve the computational efficiency of the non-local means (NLM) filter in removing random noise. The stored values are used to rapidly compute the similarity of neighboring windows by avoiding repeated summation operations, which reduces the computation time of NLM filtering. Subsequently, the optimized NLM filter is employed to remove random noise from the hologram. The denoised hologram is decomposed into structural and textural components using the TV-G algorithm. The structural component corresponds to the zero-order term while the textural component retains the interference fringes. Based on the decomposition results, the zero-order term is effectively suppressed, and the textural component is used for phase reconstruction. Additionally, the dynamic fluctuation phase maps of water droplet evaporation were retrieved to demonstrate the real-time capability of the method.
data.title_cn: 结合优化非局部均值滤波和变分图像分解模型的离轴数字全息术中的零阶抑制
data.abstract_cn: 在离轴数字全息术中，相位重建通常涉及提取+1阶项频谱，其携带样本的相位信息。然而，零阶项引起的干扰会降低提取的准确性。据我们所知，本研究提出了一种新颖的变分图像分解模型，可以有效抑制零阶项。首先构造积分图像来存储像素差平方累积和，以提高非局部均值（NLM）滤波器去除随机噪声的计算效率。存储的值用于快速计算相邻窗口的相似度，避免重复求和操作，从而减少 NLM 滤波的计算时间。随后，采用优化的 NLM 滤波器去除全息图中的随机噪声。使用 TV-G 算法将去噪全息图分解为结构和纹理分量。结构分量对应于零阶项，而纹理分量保留干涉条纹。根据分解结果，有效抑制零阶项，并利用纹理分量进行相位重建。此外，还检索了水滴蒸发的动态波动相图，以证明该方法的实时能力。

data.title: Spontaneously generated structured light via vortex beams in a five-level atomic system
data.author: Tong Zhang, Xu Deng, Kai-Kai Zhang, Tao Shui, Wen-Xing Yang
data.summary: We propose an efficient scheme to manipulate spontaneous emission spectra using optical vortices carrying orbital angular momentum (OAM) in a coherently driven cold five-level atomic system assisted by a radio frequency (RF) or microwave field. Using experimentally achievable parameters, we find that the spontaneous emission is strongly influenced by quantum destructive interference. And we show that the structured light profile of the probe field can be transferred to the spontaneous emission spectrum via spontaneously generated coherence (SGC). With the aid of SGC, the intensities and detunings of the control and RF fields can be used to tailor the vortex-induced spontaneous emission spectra. When the control and RF fields are configured as vortex beams, it is demonstrated that the spontaneous emission can be coherently controlled through quantum interference by adjusting their topological charges (TCs). Furthermore, we explore intriguing optical properties of the vortex-induced spontaneous emission by varying the TCs of the probe and control fields. This coherently driven atomic system features three closely spaced levels, giving rise to multiple vortex-induced SGC pathways. Our scheme opens avenues for applications in structured light, ranging from optical storage to optical communication.
data.title_cn: 五能级原子系统中通过涡旋光束自发产生结构光
data.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种有效的方案，在射频（RF）或微波场的辅助下，在相干驱动的冷五能级原子系统中使用携带轨道角动量（OAM）的光学涡旋来操纵自发发射光谱。使用实验可实现的参数，我们发现自发发射受到量子相消干涉的强烈影响。我们表明，探测场的结构光轮廓可以通过自发相干（SGC）转移到自发发射光谱。在 SGC 的帮助下，控制场和射频场的强度和失谐可用于定制涡流诱导自发发射光谱。当控制场和射频场配置为涡旋光束时，证明可以通过调整其拓扑电荷（TC）通过量子干涉来相干控制自发发射。此外，我们通过改变探针和控制场的 TC 来探索涡流诱导自发发射的有趣光学特性。这种连贯驱动的原子系统具有三个紧密间隔的水平，产生多个涡旋诱导的 SGC 路径。我们的方案为从光存储到光通信的结构光应用开辟了途径。

data.title: Construction of Stokes probability clouds from the polarization matrices for thermal light and polarization speckle
data.author: Wei Wang, Mitsuo Takeda
data.summary: Utilizing the eigendecomposition of the Hermitian polarization matrix, we present a geometric framework for the study of polarization speckles and partially polarized thermal light. The proposed methodology is founded on the concept of the Stokes probability cloud that provides a geometric representation of the joint probability distribution of instantaneous (or spatially localized) random Stokes vectors. In addition to the eigenvalues that specify the shape and size of the Stokes probability cloud, we will find the associated eigenvectors that define the orientation of the Stokes probability cloud. The relationship between the joint probability density and the marginal probability densities of the Stokes parameters is illustrated by projecting the Stokes probability cloud onto the axes in the three-dimensional Hilbert space. This geometrical approach provides intuitive insights into the involved mathematical relations of stochastic polarization phenomena in optics.
data.title_cn: 从热光和偏振散斑的偏振矩阵构建斯托克斯概率云
data.abstract_cn: 利用埃尔米特偏振矩阵的特征分解，我们提出了用于研究偏振散斑和部分偏振热光的几何框架。所提出的方法基于斯托克斯概率云的概念，它提供了瞬时（或空间局部）随机斯托克斯向量的联合概率分布的几何表示。除了指定斯托克斯概率云的形状和大小的特征值之外，我们还将找到定义斯托克斯概率云方向的相关特征向量。通过将斯托克斯概率云投影到三维希尔伯特空间的轴上来说明斯托克斯参数的联合概率密度和边际概率密度之间的关系。这种几何方法为光学中随机偏振现象所涉及的数学关系提供了直观的见解。

data.title: Events meet phase-shifting digital holography: practical acquisition, theory, and algorithms
data.author: Ittetsu Uchiyama, Chihiro Tsutake, Keita Takahashi, Toshiaki Fujii
data.summary: We introduce what we believe to be a novel phase-shifting digital holography (PSDH) method leveraging a hybrid event-based vision sensor (EVS). The key idea of our method is the phase shift during a single exposure. The hybrid EVS records a hologram blurred by the phase shift, together with the events corresponding to blur variations. We present analytical and optimization-based methods that theoretically support the reconstruction of full-complex wavefronts from the blurred hologram and events. The experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves a reconstruction quality comparable to that of a conventional PSDH method while enhancing the acquisition efficiency.
data.title_cn: 事件遇上相移数字全息术：实际采集、理论和算法
data.abstract_cn: 我们介绍了一种我们认为是利用混合基于事件的视觉传感器 (EVS) 的新型相移数字全息 (PSDH) 方法。我们方法的关键思想是单次曝光期间的相移。混合 EVS 记录因相移而模糊的全息图，以及与模糊变化相对应的事件。我们提出了基于分析和优化的方法，理论上支持从模糊全息图和事件重建全复杂波前。实验结果表明，我们的方法实现了与传统 PSDH 方法相当的重建质量，同时提高了采集效率。

data.title: Effective performance-enhanced CS-NFDM system employing general orthogonal circulant transform precoding
data.author: Zhihang Sun, Chenglin Bai, Yaozheng Yue, Shijie Hou, Shuzhan Liu, Xinkuo Yu, Tianchi Chen, Yuting Wu, Hengying Xu, Yining Zhang, Na Wu
data.summary: In the continuous spectrum nonlinear frequency division multiplexing (CS-NFDM) system, inter-symbol interference (ISI) and system noise exhibit non-uniform distribution characteristics on the nonlinear spectrum (NS), resulting in a significant reduction in the signal-to-interference-and-noise ratio (SINR) of subcarriers located at the edge of the spectrum, which seriously impairs the overall transmission performance of the system. This paper improves the general orthogonal circulant transform (GOCT) precoding technology and applies it to the CS-NFDM system for what we believe to be the first time, which effectively addresses the above issues, and we refer to this new system as the GOCT-NFDM system. This system employs the GOCT matrix to perform linear precoding on each subcarrier, which spreads the information on each subcarrier to all subcarriers, thereby achieving uniform SINR distribution across different NS components and effectively improving the system performance. The effectiveness of the proposed scheme is validated by building a GOCT-NFDM simulation system for 800 km transmission. Compared with the traditional CS-NFDM system, the GOCT-NFDM system achieves a 1.67 dB Q-factor gain at the optimal launch power under the transmission scenario with 128 subcarriers and a signal bandwidth of 52 GHz, and delivers a maximum Q-factor gain of 2.05 dB with 256 subcarriers and a signal bandwidth of 72 GHz. To further validate the feasibility of the proposed scheme in practical scenarios, a GOCT-NFDM experimental system for 806 km transmission is established. Compared with the traditional CS-NFDM system, the GOCT-NFDM system achieves Q-factor gains of 0.56 dB and 0.74 dB at the optimal launch power with 128 subcarriers and signal bandwidths of 40 GHz and 48 GHz, respectively. In terms of implementation complexity, the additional complexity introduced by the proposed scheme is O ( N c log ⁡ N c ). Given the significant performance improvement it brings to the CS-NFDM system, this slight increase in complexity is acceptable.
data.title_cn: 采用通用正交循环变换预编码的有效性能增强型 CS-NFDM 系统
data.abstract_cn: 在连续频谱非线性频分复用（CS-NFDM）系统中，码间干扰（ISI）和系统噪声在非线性频谱（NS）上表现出非均匀分布特征，导致位于频谱边缘的子载波的信号干扰噪声比（SINR）显着下降，严重影响系统的整体传输性能。本文改进了通用正交循环变换（GOCT）预编码技术，并将其首次应用于CS-NFDM系统，有效解决了上述问题，我们将这种新系统称为GOCT-NFDM系统。该系统采用GOCT矩阵对每个子载波进行线性预编码，将每个子载波上的信息传播到所有子载波上，从而实现不同NS分量上均匀的SINR分布，有效提高系统性能。通过搭建800 km传输的GOCT-NFDM仿真系统验证了该方案的有效性。与传统CS-NFDM系统相比，GOCT-NFDM系统在128个子载波、52GHz信号带宽的传输场景下，在最佳发射功率下实现了1.67dB的Q值增益，在256个子载波、72GHz信号带宽的传输场景下，最大Q值增益为2.05dB。为了进一步验证该方案在实际场景中的可行性，建立了806 km传输的GOCT-NFDM实验系统。与传统CS-NFDM系统相比，GOCT-NFDM系统在128个子载波、信号带宽40 GHz和48 GHz的最佳发射功率下分别实现了0.56 dB和0.74 dB的Q因子增益。就实现复杂度而言，所提出的方案引入的额外复杂度为 O ( N c log ⁡ N c )。考虑到它给 CS-NFDM 系统带来的显着性能改进，这种复杂性的轻微增加是可以接受的。

data.title: Laser-machined, kilowatt-class cladding light strippers with stripping efficiencies > 37 dB
data.author: Nils Haverland, Finn Salhoff, Fabian Kranert, Jörg Neumann, Dietmar Kracht
data.summary: Cladding light strippers are a crucial component for fiber-based laser and amplifier systems, stripping unabsorbed pump light behind the active fiber. Laser-machining presents an effective alternative to chemical etching in the production of high-power cladding light strippers. Here, we present improvements to laser-machined, microstructured cladding light strippers, which achieve cladding light attenuation up to 37.3 dB on a length of just 60 mm. We tested the high-power stripping capability of a cladding light stripper, achieving a stripped cladding light power of 1.2 kW. The result was limited by the available power. The cladding light strippers were designed by utilizing raytracing simulations to optimize the microstructure on the fiber towards homogenized stripping and increased cladding light attenuation. Afterwards, the most promising results were transferred to manufacturing and characterized. The availability of high-power, high attenuation microstructured cladding light strippers can help to improve future laser systems, possibly foregoing the need for chemical etching.
data.title_cn: 激光加工的千瓦级包层光剥离器，剥离效率 > 37 dB
data.abstract_cn: 包层光剥离器是基于光纤的激光和放大器系统的关键组件，可剥离有源光纤后面未吸收的泵浦光。在高功率包层光剥离器的生产中，激光加工是化学蚀刻的有效替代方案。在这里，我们展示了对激光加工的微结构熔覆光剥离器的改进，它在仅 60 毫米的长度上实现了高达 37.3 dB 的熔覆光衰减。我们测试了包层光剥离器的高功率剥离能力，实现了1.2kW的剥离包层光功率。结果受到可用功率的限制。包层光剥离器的设计利用光线追踪模拟来优化光纤的微观结构，以实现均匀剥离和增加包层光衰减。随后，最有希望的结果被转移到制造中并进行表征。高功率、高衰减微结构熔覆光剥离器的出现有助于改进未来的激光系统，甚至可能不需要化学蚀刻。

data.title: Measuring the number of modes guided by multi-mode hollow core fibres
data.author: Robbie Mears, Kerrianne Harrington, William J. Wadsworth, David M. Bird, James M. Stone, Tim A. Birks
data.summary: We report a method to experimentally estimate the effective number of modes guided by multi-mode anti-resonant hollow core optical fibres using their far field intensity distributions. With a simple experimental setup and incoherent illumination, an arbitrary number of modes can be measured quickly and accurately.
data.title_cn: 测量多模空心光纤引导的模式数量
data.abstract_cn: 我们报告了一种利用远场强度分布实验估计多模反谐振空心光纤引导的有效模式数量的方法。通过简单的实验装置和不相干照明，可以快速准确地测量任意数量的模式。

data.title: Noise analysis method for frequency transfer systems by using ADEV combined with EMD-WT
data.author: Xuan Yang, Junhui Li, Bin Luo, Ziyang Chen, Hong Guo
data.summary: In precision frequency transfer systems, stringent requirements are imposed on the phase stability of transmitted signals. Throughout the transmission process, the inherent challenges of long-haul signal propagation inevitably introduce multiple noise components, including, but not limited to, thermal noise, phase fluctuations, and environmental interference. The system is inclined to use the conventional evaluation index – Allan deviation (ADEV) to reflect the system stability in order to evaluate the noise level. Whereas, ADEV can only provide numerical expression and lacks the time-frequency details, a complete evaluation system is therefore required by the system. In this paper, we present a groundbreaking integration of ADEV and wavelet-transformed empirical mode decomposition (EMD-WT), establishing a novel analytical framework that enables simultaneous characterization of noise types and time-frequency domain properties. This synergistic approach achieves unprecedented dual-domain resolution in noise discrimination in frequency transfer systems.
data.title_cn: ADEV结合EMD-WT的变频系统噪声分析方法
data.abstract_cn: 在精密频率传输系统中，对传输信号的相位稳定性提出了严格的要求。在整个传输过程中，长距离信号传播的固有挑战不可避免地引入多种噪声成分，包括但不限于热噪声、相位波动和环境干扰。系统倾向于使用常规的评价指标——阿伦偏差（ADEV）来反映系统的稳定性，以评价噪声水平。而ADEV只能提供数值表达，缺乏时频细节，因此系统需要一个完整的评估体系。在本文中，我们提出了 ADEV 和小波变换经验模态分解 (EMD-WT) 的突破性集成，建立了一种新颖的分析框架，可以同时表征噪声类型和时频域属性。这种协同方法在频率传输系统中的噪声辨别方面实现了前所未有的双域分辨率。

data.title: Hyperspectral imaging of downconverted photons in angle phase-matched nonlinear crystals
data.author: Evan J. Kumar, Lorenzo Uboldi, Cristian Manzoni, Giulio Cerullo, Ajay Ram Srimath Kandada
data.summary: Spontaneous Parametric Downconversion (SPDC) is key to generating broadband spectrally entangled photons for quantum optical spectroscopy. Here, we use a common-path birefringent interferometer to experimentally map the spatial-spectral distribution of SPDC in Type I and II β -barium borate crystals using hyperspectral k-space imaging. Under broadband pulsed pumping, we observe strong spatial variations in the spectra, with distinct features for each phase-matching type. Simulations based on biphoton amplitudes and phase-matching conditions qualitatively match our results. This spatial-spectral mapping enables control over biphoton entanglement entropy, paving the way for optimized quantum-light sources for material spectroscopy.
data.title_cn: 角度相位匹配非线性晶体中下转换光子的高光谱成像
data.abstract_cn: 自发参量下转换 (SPDC) 是生成用于量子光谱的宽带光谱纠缠光子的关键。在这里，我们使用共光路双折射干涉仪，通过高光谱 k 空间成像实验绘制 I 型和 II 型 β-硼酸钡晶体中 SPDC 的空间光谱分布。在宽带脉冲泵浦下，我们观察到光谱中强烈的空间变化，每种相位匹配类型具有独特的特征。基于双光子振幅和相位匹配条件的模拟与我们的结果定性匹配。这种空间光谱映射可以控制双光子纠缠熵，为优化材料光谱的量子光源铺平道路。

data.title: Artificial gauge field engineered waveguide superlattices for high-performance thermo-optic switches
data.author: Xuelin Zhang, Jiangbing Du, Ke Xu, Zuyuan He
data.summary: Photonic switching technologies have been proffered as competitive replacements for electronic switches, due to high power efficiency, high bandwidth density, and low cost. Here, a high-performance 1 × 8 thermo-optic switch based on artificial gauge field engineered waveguide superlattices is proposed. This switch exhibits an average insertion loss of 1.96 dB and keeps crosstalk below −20 dB over a 60 nm bandwidth. By leveraging topology optimization, this thermo-optic phase shifter eliminates the need for intricate air-trench or undercut processes while delivering exceptional metrics: low power consumption (2.52 mW/ π ), low loss (0.4 dB), sub-1V driving voltage for 2 π tuning, wideband operation (60 nm), and a compact footprint (245 μm × 15 μm).
data.title_cn: 用于高性能热光开关的人工规范场工程波导超晶格
data.abstract_cn: 由于高功率效率、高带宽密度和低成本，光子开关技术已成为电子开关的有竞争力的替代品。在此，提出了一种基于人工规范场工程波导超晶格的高性能 1 × 8 热光开关。该开关的平均插入损耗为 1.96 dB，并且在 60 nm 带宽内将串扰保持在 -20 dB 以下。通过利用拓扑优化，这种热光移相器无需复杂的空气沟槽或底切工艺，同时提供卓越的指标：低功耗 (2.52 mW/π)、低损耗 (0.4 dB)、用于 2 π 调谐的低于 1V 驱动电压、宽带操作 (60 nm) 和紧凑的占位面积 (245 μm × 15 μm)。

data.title: Manipulation of the orbital angular momentum of soft X-ray beams by consecutive diffractive optics
data.author: Nazir Khan, Rahul Jangid, Taras Stanislavchuk, Aaron Stein, Oleg Chubar, Andi Barbour, Andrei Sirenko, Valery Kiryukhin, Claudio Mazzoli
data.summary: Production and manipulation of orbital angular momentum (OAM) of coherent soft X-ray beams is demonstrated utilizing consecutive diffractive optics. OAM addition is observed upon passing the beam through consecutive fork gratings. The OAM of the beam was found to be decoupled from its spin angular momentum (SAM). Practical implementation of angular momentum control by consecutive devices in the X-ray regime opens new experimental opportunities, such as direct measurement of the beam’s OAM without resorting to phase-sensitive techniques, including holography. OAM analyzers utilizing fork gratings can be used to characterize the beams produced by synchrotron and free electron lasers sources; they can also be used in scattering experiments.
data.title_cn: 通过连续衍射光学器件操纵软 X 射线束的轨道角动量
data.abstract_cn: 利用连续衍射光学器件演示了相干软 X 射线束的轨道角动量 (OAM) 的产生和操纵。当光束通过连续的叉形光栅时，可以观察到 OAM 的增加。研究发现，光束的 OAM 与其自旋角动量 (SAM) 是解耦的。在 X 射线范围内通过连续设备实际实现角动量控制开辟了新的实验机会，例如直接测量光束的 OAM，而无需求助于包括全息术在内的相敏技术。利用叉形光栅的 OAM 分析仪可用于表征同步加速器和自由电子激光源产生的光束；它们也可用于散射实验。

data.title: High-precision FBG sensor demodulation based on a tunable Michelson interferometer with parallel FBGs
data.author: Tingfeng Li, Shuo Wang, Fengyi Chen, Ruohui Wang, Xueguang Qiao
data.summary: A high-precision signal demodulation scheme for fiber Bragg grating (FBG) is presented. The scheme utilizes a piezoelectric transducer (PZT) tuned co-located, multi-wavelength tunable FBGs (CMWT-FBGs) in one arm of the Michelson interferometer (MI), which adjusts its central-wavelength range to fully cover the wavelength shifts of the sensing FBG. The algorithm module utilizes a Savitzky-Golay (S-G) fitting algorithm to precisely locate the envelope peak of the interference signal, thereby accurately reconstructing the variations of the sensing FBG’s central wavelength. Experimental results demonstrate that the modulation-demodulation scheme achieves a temperature accuracy of 1.33×10 −6 °C and a strain accuracy of 1.04×10 −5 μ ε , respectively. These results show that the CMWT-FBGs-MI system offers a competitive advantage in high-speed and high-precision signal measurement, providing experimental and theoretical support for advancements in related fields.
data.title_cn: 基于具有并行 FBG 的可调谐迈克尔逊干涉仪的高精度 FBG 传感器解调
data.abstract_cn: 提出了一种光纤布拉格光栅（FBG）高精度信号解调方案。该方案在迈克尔逊干涉仪 (MI) 的一个臂中利用压电换能器 (PZT) 调谐并置的多波长可调谐 FBG (CMWT-FBG)，调整其中心波长范围以完全覆盖传感 FBG 的波长偏移。该算法模块利用Savitzky-Golay（S-G）拟合算法精确定位干涉信号的包络峰值，从而准确地重建传感FBG中心波长的变化。实验结果表明，调制解调方案的温度精度为1.33×10 -6 °C，应变精度为1.04×10 -5 με。这些结果表明CMWT-FBGs-MI系统在高速、高精度信号测量方面具有竞争优势，为相关领域的进步提供了实验和理论支持。

data.title: Phase stabilization for long-baseline interferometry of incoherent optical sources
data.author: Joshua J. Collier, John S. Wallis, Benjamin P. Dix-Matthews, David R. Gozzard
data.summary: The maximum baseline, and therefore resolution, of optical astronomical interferometers is limited by attenuation and phase noise within the optical path between the apertures and beam combiner, as well as the practical challenges of constructing optical delay lines more than a few hundred meters in length. We implement off-band phase stabilization on two fiber optic links of 85 km, creating a total baseline of 170 km. We show that the system is able to effectively phase stabilize signals from an incoherent pseudo-thermal source with a bandwidth of 11.2 nm. We are able to reduce the phase noise by 4–5 orders of magnitude between 1 and 100 Hz, such that we could resolve an applied phase difference of 0.16 cycles per second with continuous measurement. We show that, with phase stabilization active, the interferometer is able to recover both first-order and second-order photon correlations. These results demonstrate the feasibility of this technique for long-baseline optical and quantum astronomical interferometers. The present results are limited by chromatic dispersion within the fiber, which can be mitigated using dispersion-compensating modules.
data.title_cn: 非相干光源长基线干涉测量的相位稳定
data.abstract_cn: 光学天文干涉仪的最大基线和分辨率受到孔径和光束组合器之间光路内的衰减和相位噪声以及构造长度超过数百米的光学延迟线的实际挑战的限制。我们在两条 85 公里长的光纤链路上实施带外相位稳定，创建了 170 公里的总基线。我们表明，该系统能够有效地稳定来自带宽为 11.2 nm 的非相干赝热源的信号。我们能够将 1 到 100 Hz 之间的相位噪声降低 4-5 个数量级，这样我们就可以通过连续测量解决每秒 0.16 个周期的应用相位差。我们表明，在相位稳定激活的情况下，干涉仪能够恢复一阶和二阶光子相关性。这些结果证明了该技术对于长基线光学和量子天文干涉仪的可行性。目前的结果受到光纤内色散的限制，可以使用色散补偿模块来减轻色散。

data.title: Enhanced spectral-domain phase microscopy for high-sensitivity and broad-range quantitative phase imaging via joint algorithm-hardware calibration
data.author: Jiayi Wang, Liuhang Zhao, Runnan Zhang, Zihao Zhou, Wei Yin, Xin Yuan, Ning Zhou, Chao Zuo
data.summary: Spectral-domain phase microscopy (SDPM) enables high-sensitivity quantitative phase imaging by retrieving phase information directly from the interference spectrum, mitigating the axial-resolution penalty caused by spectral leakage in the discrete Fourier transform (DFT). However, conventional SDPM remains highly sensitive to abrupt phase gradients and noise, often leading to wrap mismatches and global bias that restrict its measurement range. In this Letter, we propose enhanced SDPM (eSDPM), an algorithm-hardware co-calibration framework that achieves high precision, bias-free phase reconstruction over an extended measurement range. On the algorithmic side, we explicitly model endpoint terms in the spectral phase, estimate a reference phase within a safe operating band, and determine a wavenumber anchor from the centroid of the source spectrum. On the hardware side, controlled spectral truncation and boundary-wavelength calibration minimize endpoint bias and wavelength misalignment. Experiments on biological and industrial samples demonstrate that eSDPM achieves continuous, bias-free, and high-accuracy optical path difference reconstruction over a broad measurement range, establishing it as a robust and practical approach for wide-range quantitative phase imaging.
data.title_cn: 通过联合算法-硬件校准实现高灵敏度和宽范围定量相位成像的增强型谱域相位显微镜
data.abstract_cn: 谱域相位显微镜 (SDPM) 通过直接从干涉光谱中检索相位信息来实现高灵敏度定量相位成像，从而减轻离散傅里叶变换 (DFT) 中光谱泄漏造成的轴向分辨率损失。然而，传统的 SDPM 对突然的相位梯度和噪声仍然高度敏感，通常会导致环绕失配和全局偏差，从而限制其测量范围。在这封信中，我们提出了增强型 SDPM (eSDPM)，这是一种算法-硬件协同校准框架，可在扩展的测量范围内实现高精度、无偏差相位重建。在算法方面，我们明确地对光谱相位中的端点项进行建模，估计安全工作频带内的参考相位，并从源光谱的质心确定波数锚点。在硬件方面，受控光谱截断和边界波长校准可最大限度地减少端点偏差和波长未对准。对生物和工业样品的实验表明，eSDPM 在较宽的测量范围内实现了连续、无偏差和高精度的光程差重建，使其成为一种稳健且实用的宽范围定量相位成像方法。

data.title: High-precision chirp-rate measurement of LFM microwave signals via photonic fractional Fourier transform with low-frequency detection
data.author: Di Peng, Jingyi Zhang, Zewen Zhu, Ya Han, Heyun Tan, Songnian Fu, Shuoyang Qiu, Yuwen Qin
data.summary: We propose and demonstrate a method for high-precision chirp-rate measurement of linear frequency-modulated (LFM) microwave signals. By leveraging tunable fractional Fourier transform within an optical frequency-shift loop, the system processes LFM microwave signals in the optical domain and extracts their chirp rates via low-frequency detection, avoiding the need for high-speed electronics. In the experiment, chirp-rate measurement across a range of −1400 MHz/µs to 800 MHz/µs is achieved, with errors below ±0.2 MHz/µs. This high measurement precision is maintained over a signal frequency range of 5 GHz to 40 GHz, even at a signal-to-noise ratio of −7.55 dB. Moreover, the method is capable of measuring the chirp rates of multiple spectrally overlapping LFM microwave signals. These results validate the proposed method as a robust and simplified chirp-rate measurement solution in advanced electronic reconnaissance applications.
data.title_cn: 通过光子分数傅里叶变换和低频检测对 LFM 微波信号进行高精度线性调频测量
data.abstract_cn: 我们提出并演示了一种线性调频 (LFM) 微波信号的高精度线性调频频率测量方法。通过利用光学频移环路中的可调谐分数傅立叶变换，该系统可以在光域中处理 LFM 微波信号，并通过低频检测提取其线性调频频率，从而无需使用高速电子设备。在实验中，实现了-1400 MHz/μs至800 MHz/μs范围内的线性调频脉冲测量，误差低于±0.2 MHz/μs。即使信噪比为-7.55 dB，在 5 GHz 至 40 GHz 的信号频率范围内也能保持这种高测量精度。此外，该方法能够测量多个频谱重叠的LFM微波信号的啁啾率。这些结果验证了所提出的方法是先进电子侦察应用中稳健且简化的线性调频频率测量解决方案。

data.title: Non-destructive micro-patterned elastic ultra-thin films for high-resolution skin-like OLEDs
data.author: Juntong Li, Xiaoli Zhao, Hongyan Yu, Yao Fu, Peng Xue, Guodong Zhao, Mingxin Zhang, Yanhong Tong, Qingxin Tang, Yichun Liu
data.summary: Skin-like organic light-emitting diodes (OLEDs) have garnered attention for their potential in wearable displays, implantable electronics, and biomedical sensing. However, creating high-resolution, mechanically stable OLEDs remains challenging. This study proposes a simple, non-destructive patterning technique to eliminate the thermal expansion mismatch between photoresist and ultra-thin elastomer films. Polyvinyl alcohol is used as a protective layer to allow the elastic ultra-thin films to be micro-patterned to within 2 µm, giving a resolution of up to 6349 pixels per inch (PPI). This work enhances the stability of micro-patterned pixel-defining layers (PDL) in optical manufacturing, thereby contributing to the development of high-resolution displays.
data.title_cn: 用于高分辨率类肤OLED的无损微图案弹性超薄膜
data.abstract_cn: 类皮肤有机发光二极管 (OLED) 因其在可穿戴显示器、植入式电子产品和生物医学传感方面的潜力而受到关注。然而，制造高分辨率、机械稳定的 OLED 仍然具有挑战性。这项研究提出了一种简单的、非破坏性的图案化技术，以消除光刻胶和超薄弹性体薄膜之间的热膨胀失配。使用聚乙烯醇作为保护层，使弹性超薄膜能够形成 2 µm 以内的微图案，分辨率高达每英寸 6349 像素 (PPI)。这项工作增强了光学制造中微图案像素定义层（PDL）的稳定性，从而有助于高分辨率显示器的开发。

data.title: Optical control of vortex lattices and magnetostriction in a confined quantum ferrofluid
data.author: Biao Dong, Xiao-Fei Zhang, YongChang Zhang
data.summary: The ability to engineer topological states of matter with light is a central goal of quantum optics. We demonstrate that the anisotropic dipole–dipole interaction (DDI), tunable via optical Feshbach resonances, provides a powerful optical knob for controlling quantized vortices in quantum ferrofluids. We show that DDI-induced magnetostriction, which elongates the atomic cloud, acts as an effective optical lensing effect that reduces the transverse condensate size. This dramatically lowers the critical rotation frequency for vortex nucleation, enabling the formation of vortex lattices at interaction strengths previously inaccessible due to collapse. Our work establishes a general all-optical framework for sculpting topological excitations in magnetic atoms, with implications for quantum simulation and the study of anisotropic quantum turbulence.
data.title_cn: 受限量子铁磁流体中涡旋晶格和磁致伸缩的光学控制
data.abstract_cn: 用光设计物质拓扑态的能力是量子光学的核心目标。我们证明，可通过光学费什巴赫共振调节的各向异性偶极-偶极相互作用（DDI）为控制量子铁磁流体中的量子化涡旋提供了强大的光学旋钮。我们证明，DDI 引起的磁致伸缩可以拉长原子云，起到有效的光学透镜效应的作用，可以减小横向凝聚体的尺寸。这极大地降低了涡旋成核的临界旋转频率，从而能够以以前因塌陷而无法达到的相互作用强度形成涡旋晶格。我们的工作建立了一个通用的全光学框架，用于雕刻磁性原子中的拓扑激发，对量子模拟和各向异性量子湍流的研究具有影响。

data.title: Probing subradiant dynamics in cold atomic ensembles via population and emitted light measurements
data.author: Antoine Glicenstein, Daniel Benedicto Orenes, Apoorva Apoorva, Raphaël Saint-Jalm, Robin Kaiser
data.summary: In this letter, we report on the time- and space-resolved measurement of subradiant excited state population in an ultra-cold atomic cloud of 174Yb atoms. We use a depletion imaging technique that exploits the V-type internal energy structure of alkaline-earth-like atoms to directly observe the time-resolved spatial distribution of excited state population. We characterize the decay dynamics of the subradiant modes using both the excited state population and scattered light intensity, finding good quantitative agreement with numerical predictions from simulations of two-level atomic ensembles.
data.title_cn: 通过布居和发射光测量探测冷原子系综中的次辐射动力学
data.abstract_cn: 在这封信中，我们报告了 174Yb 原子超冷原子云中次辐射激发态布居的时间和空间分辨测量。我们使用耗尽成像技术，利用类碱土原子的V型内能结构来直接观察激发态布居的时间分辨空间分布。我们使用激发态布居和散射光强度来表征次辐射模式的衰变动力学，发现与两级原子系综模拟的数值预测具有良好的定量一致性。

data.title: Generation of multi-μJ few-cycle blue self-compressed soliton pulses in large-core hollow-capillary fibers
data.author: Ziping Huang, Jiale Peng, Weitao He, Hongyu Chen, Chengbo Sun, Zhihao Wang, Shuangxi Peng, Lixin He, Zuofei Hong, Qingbin Zhang, Peixiang Lu
data.summary: In this work, 7.63 μJ few-cycle blue self-compressed soliton pulses are generated by combining efficient broadband frequency doubling, multiplate continuum (MPC) generation with blue pulse self-compression in He-filled hollow-capillary fibers (HCF). The multi-stage pre-compression setup creates optimal conditions for self-compression in HCF. By utilizing large-core HCFs instead of micro-structured fibers, we achieve a 7.63 μJ pulse energy. Dispersion analysis reveals the generation of a near-4.4 fs blue soliton. Numerical studies reveal our scheme’s robustness under the perturbation of high-order dispersion and highlight its potential for energy scaling. Moreover, our scheme eliminates the dispersion management components for the final spectral broadening stage in post-compression schemes. This work paves the way for generating energetic ultrashort blue pulses, which show significant value in numerous strong-field and ultrafast applications.
data.title_cn: 在大芯空心毛细管光纤中产生多μJ少周期蓝色自压缩孤子脉冲
data.abstract_cn: 在这项工作中，通过将高效的宽带倍频、多板连续谱 (MPC) 生成与氦填充空心毛细管纤维 (HCF) 中的蓝色脉冲自压缩相结合，生成了 7.63 μJ 少周期蓝色自压缩孤子脉冲。多级预压缩设置为 HCF 中的自压缩创造了最佳条件。通过利用大芯 HCF 代替微结构光纤，我们实现了 7.63 μJ 的脉冲能量。色散分析揭示了近 4.4 fs 蓝色孤子的生成。数值研究揭示了我们的方案在高阶色散扰动下的鲁棒性，并强调了其能量缩放的潜力。此外，我们的方案消除了后压缩方案中最后光谱展宽阶段的色散管理组件。这项工作为产生高能超短蓝色脉冲铺平了道路，该脉冲在众多强场和超快应用中显示出重要价值。

data.title: High-resolution aberration-free imaging through GRIN fiber using speckle illumination and compressive sensing
data.author: M. S. Pochechuev, A. Dharmasiri, T. I. Rajib, A. M. Zheltikov
data.summary: Graded index (GRIN) lenses are essential for in vivo imaging and endoscopy. Implantable probes made from short segments of standard GRIN fiber offer important benefits over commercial GRIN lenses; however, they struggle with aberrations. This study introduces a technique that combines structured speckle illumination with compressive sensing (CS) to enable aberration-free imaging with GRIN fiber-based probes. We develop a wave-optic mode-expansion model to simulate the propagation of coherent illumination and incoherent fluorescence response in an aberrated GRIN probe. Through numerical experiments involving sequential speckle illumination and CS for image reconstruction, we achieve high-resolution, aberration-free imaging throughout the entire field of view (FOV). In contrast to standard microscopy methods, the reconstructed image quality is independent of the fiber length. The proposed method opens avenues to minimally invasive single- and multisite deep brain microscopy.
data.title_cn: 使用散斑照明和压缩传感通过 GRIN 光纤进行高分辨率无像差成像
data.abstract_cn: 渐变折射率 (GRIN) 镜片对于体内成像和内窥镜检查至关重要。由短段标准 GRIN 光纤制成的植入式探头比商用 GRIN 透镜具有重要优势；然而，他们却在与畸变作斗争。这项研究引入了一种将结构化散斑照明与压缩传感 (CS) 相结合的技术，以利用基于 GRIN 光纤的探头实现无像差成像。我们开发了一种波光模式扩展模型来模拟像差 GRIN 探针中相干照明和非相干荧光响应的传播。通过涉及顺序散斑照明和图像重建的 CS 的数值实验，我们在整个视场 (FOV) 内实现了高分辨率、无像差成像。与标准显微镜方法相比，重建图像质量与纤维长度无关。所提出的方法为微创单位点和多位点深部脑显微镜检查开辟了途径。

data.title: High-field multi-cycle terahertz emission from axially cut β-BBO crystals reaching several hundred kV/cm
data.author: Xianghe Feng, Alexander H. Ohrt, Long Cheng, Oliver Nagy, Guochun Zhang, Peter Uhd Jepsen, Rukang Li, Binbin Zhou
data.summary: We report efficient generation of high-field multi-cycle terahertz (THz) radiation from optical rectification (OR) in axially cut β-barium borate (β-BBO) crystals driven by an 800 nm femtosecond laser. Both b-cut and c-cut crystals produce coherent THz waveforms featuring two narrowband components centered near 10 THz and 14 THz, with weaker sidebands extending up to 25 THz. At a pump power of 3.95 W, the b-cut crystal delivers 34 µW of THz power and a focused peak field of 355 kV/cm, while the thinner c-cut crystal achieves comparable output and a higher peak field of 390 kV/cm. The high-field strength, experimental simplicity, and high scalability potential make axially cut β-BBO a compact and robust solid-state source for driving strong-field dynamics and fundamental excitations in the 5–15 THz range.
data.title_cn: 轴向切割 β-BBO 晶体的高场多周期太赫兹发射达到数百 kV/cm
data.abstract_cn: 我们报告了由 800 nm 飞秒激光器驱动的轴向切割 β-硼酸钡 (β-BBO) 晶体中的光学整流 (OR) 有效产生高场多周期太赫兹 (THz) 辐射。 b 切和 c 切晶体都会产生相干太赫兹波形，具有两个以 10 太赫兹和 14 太赫兹为中心的窄带分量，较弱的边带延伸至 25 太赫兹。在泵浦功率为 3.95 W 时，b 切割晶体可提供 34 µW 太赫兹功率和 355 kV/cm 的聚焦峰值场，而更薄的 c 切割晶体可实现相当的输出和 390 kV/cm 的更高峰值场。高场强、实验简单性和高可扩展性潜力使轴向切割 β-BBO 成为紧凑而坚固的固态源，用于驱动 5-15 THz 范围内的强场动力学和基本激励。

data.title: Maskless and on-chip LED-array microscope with spatially varying angle calibration for centimeter-scale phase imaging
data.author: Sibi Chakravarthy Shanmugavel, Vindya Senanayake, Donghwa Suh, Jeffrey M. Gross, Shwetadwip Chowdhury
data.summary: Conventional lens-based microscopes are constrained by a trade-off between resolution and field-of-view (FOV), which limits overall imaging throughput. Recent works have shown that on-chip imaging systems with LED-array-based illumination offer a cost-effective approach for large FOV phase imaging. However, this strategy faces two main challenges: (1) twin-image ambiguity can degrade phase reconstruction. While mask-based modulation can help, it adds system complexity due to fabrication and alignment requirements; and (2) the illumination angle from each LED varies across large FOVs and can degrade centimeter-scale phase reconstruction without calibration. Here, we present a computational framework to jointly achieve mask-free on-chip phase imaging and adaptive calibration of spatially varying illumination angles. The sensor FOV is divided into subregions, within each of which LED illumination is approximated as planar. LED illumination angles for each subregion are initialized geometrically. Phase retrieval is then performed within each subregion by constraining the reconstruction with a soft optical transparency prior while simultaneously refining angle estimates. Reconstructed phase maps are merged to produce a high-quality, large-FOV phase image. We demonstrate this approach by achieving centimeter-scale on-chip phase imaging (up to 2.7×1.7cm 2 ) with micron-scale resolution across various biological tissue sections. This approach provides a simple, low-cost, and scalable solution for large-FOV and label-free imaging.
data.title_cn: 无掩模片上 LED 阵列显微镜，具有用于厘米级相位成像的空间变化角度校准
data.abstract_cn: 传统的基于镜头的显微镜受到分辨率和视场 (FOV) 之间权衡的限制，这限制了整体成像吞吐量。最近的研究表明，采用基于 LED 阵列的照明的片上成像系统为大视场相位成像提供了一种经济有效的方法。然而，该策略面临两个主要挑战：（1）双图像模糊性会降低相位重建。虽然基于掩模的调制可以提供帮助，但由于制造和对准要求，它增加了系统的复杂性； (2) 每个 LED 的照明角度在大视场范围内会有所不同，并且会在没有校准的情况下降低厘米级相位重建的性能。在这里，我们提出了一个计算框架，以共同实现无掩模片上相位成像和空间变化照明角度的自适应校准。传感器 FOV 分为多个子区域，每个子区域内的 LED 照明近似为平面。每个子区域的 LED 照明角度均以几何方式初始化。然后通过先用软光学透明度约束重建，同时细化角度估计，在每个子区域内执行相位恢复。重建的相位图被合并以产生高质量、大视场的相位图像。我们通过在各种生物组织切片上实现具有微米级分辨率的厘米级片上相位成像（高达 2.7×1.7cm 2 ）来演示这种方法。这种方法为大视场和无标记成像提供了一种简单、低成本且可扩展的解决方案。

data.title: Generating multi-wavelength phase screens for atmospheric wave optics simulations using fast Fourier transforms
data.author: Milo Hyde, Mark Spencer, Matthew Kalensky
data.summary: We present a method to synthesize phase screens for multi-wavelength, atmospheric wave optics simulations using fast Fourier transforms. We validate our work by comparing the theoretical, two-wavelength optical path length structure function to simulated results, and we find the two to be in excellent agreement. Our phase screen synthesis method will be useful in two-wavelength adaptive optics simulations in strong or deep turbulence.
data.title_cn: 使用快速傅里叶变换生成用于大气波光学模拟的多波长相位屏幕
data.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种使用快速傅立叶变换来合成多波长大气波光学模拟的相位屏幕的方法。我们通过将理论双波长光路长度结构函数与模拟结果进行比较来验证我们的工作，我们发现两者非常一致。我们的相位屏幕合成方法将适用于强湍流或深度湍流中的双波长自适应光学模拟。

data.title: Antisymmetric Mueller generator as the universal origin of geometric phase in classical polarization and quantum two-level systems
data.author: Jose Gil
data.summary: We show that the antisymmetric Mueller generator provides a universal algebraic kernel for geometric phase in classical polarization optics and in quantum two-level systems. For any ideal retarder, the antisymmetric 3x3 block of its Mueller matrix (the antisymmetric generator of the adjoint SU(2) action on the Stokes vector) encodes the angular-velocity vector that drives the tangential motion on the Poincar\'e sphere and fully determines the Pancharatnam-Berry phase, while the symmetric block is geometrically neutral. The same antisymmetric generator governs the evolution of pure qubit states on the Bloch sphere. This unified viewpoint yields operational criteria to identify and control geometric-phase contributions from measured Mueller matrices and from qubit process tomography.
data.title_cn: 反对称穆勒发生器作为经典偏振和量子二能级系统中几何相位的普遍起源
data.abstract_cn: 我们证明反对称穆勒发生器为经典偏振光学和量子二能级系统中的几何相位提供了通用代数核。对于任何理想的延迟器，其 Mueller 矩阵的反对称 3x3 块（斯托克斯矢量上的伴随 SU(2) 作用的反对称生成器）对驱动庞加莱球上切向运动的角速度矢量进行编码，并完全确定 Pancharatnam-Berry 相位，而对称块在几何上是中性的。相同的反对称生成器控制着布洛赫球上纯量子位态的演化。这种统一的观点产生了操作标准，用于识别和控制来自测量的穆勒矩阵和量子位过程断层扫描的几何相位贡献。

data.title: Robust photon-level single-pixel imaging through diverse scattering media
data.author: Futong Zhang, Kai Song, Yaoxing Bian, Shijun Zhao, Hongrui Liu, Hongda Ge, Lei Han, Yichen Yu, Weifeng Zhang, Dong Wang, Liantuan Xiao
data.summary: Imaging through scattering media holds significant application potential in remote sensing, biomedical diagnostics, and industrial detection. However, conventional imaging systems fail to maintain robustness and generalization across diverse environments. Here, we demonstrate a photon-level single-pixel imaging system that exploits data-domain alignment to overcome this limitation. By coupling a physical preprocessing module with a deep neural network, the system translates scattering-induced degradations from different scattering media into a unified data domain, preserving the essential structure of the optical information. Under natural fog and rain conditions, the proposed method clearly reconstructs the fine target details at a distance of 150 m, demonstrating strong robustness across the scattering medium. With 0.088 photons per pattern per pixel in a single measurement, the 256×256 dynamic imaging is well reconstructed. These results establish a generalizable framework for photon-level imaging in diverse scattering media and highlight its promise for robust optical imaging under extreme atmospheric conditions.
data.title_cn: 通过多种散射介质实现稳健的光子级单像素成像
data.abstract_cn: 通过散射介质成像在遥感、生物医学诊断和工业检测方面具有巨大的应用潜力。然而，传统的成像系统无法在不同的环境中保持鲁棒性和通用性。在这里，我们演示了一种光子级单像素成像系统，该系统利用数据域对齐来克服这一限制。通过将物理预处理模块与深度神经网络相结合，该系统将不同散射介质的散射引起的退化转化为统一的数据域，从而保留光学信息的基本结构。在自然雾和雨条件下，该方法清晰地重建了150 m距离处的精细目标细节，在散射介质上表现出很强的鲁棒性。单次测量中每个图案每个像素 0.088 个光子，可以很好地重建 256×256 动态成像。这些结果为不同散射介质中的光子级成像建立了一个可推广的框架，并强调了其在极端大气条件下实现稳健光学成像的前景。

data.title: Boosting NIR‐II/III Luminescence via Fe 3+ ‐Ni 2+ Energy Channels and Crystal Field Modulation in Monoclinic Double Perovskites
data.author: Xiaomeng Wang, Jiaren Du, Hengwei Lin
data.summary: ABSTRACT Blue‐light‐excitable near‐infrared (NIR) emitting materials exhibit significant potential for compact light sources in bioimaging, nondestructive detection, and night vision. However, achieving efficient NIR‐II/III (1000–1800 nm) emission under blue excitation remains challenging due to the large excitation–emission Stokes shift and the forbidden nature of f – f or d – d transitions. In this study, we report on the Ni 2 + ‐doped monoclinic double perovskite Ca 2 ScTaO 6 , which exhibits broadband NIR‐II/III with a full width at half maximum of 240 nm and a photoluminescence quantum yield of approximately 21% when excited at 425 nm. The incorporation of Fe 3+ ions significantly improves the photoluminescence quantum yield to approximately 37% through energy transfer pathways from Fe 3+ to Ni 2+ and crystal field modulation. Structural and spectroscopic investigations reveal the presence of Fe 3+ ions at various lattice sites, resulting in localized distortions that facilitate the relaxation of d – d transitions in Ni 2+ . A prototype NIR light‐emitting diode utilizing Ca 2 ScTaO 6 :Fe 3+ , Ni 2+ exhibits strong NIR‐II/III emission, facilitating the visualization of subsurface damage in various materials, including fruits, capsules, meat, and silicon wafers. This work demonstrates an effective strategy for designing blue‐light‐excitable NIR materials through synergistic energy transfer and crystal field engineering.
data.title_cn: 通过单斜双钙钛矿中的 Fe 3+ ‐Ni 2+ 能量通道和晶体场调制增强 NIR-II/III 发光
data.abstract_cn: 摘要：蓝光激发近红外 (NIR) 发射材料在生物成像、无损检测和夜视领域作为紧凑型光源具有巨大的潜力。然而，由于激发-发射斯托克斯位移较大以及 f – f 或 d – d 跃迁的禁禁性质，在蓝色激发下实现高效的 NIR-II/III (1000–1800 nm) 发射仍然具有挑战性。在这项研究中，我们报道了Ni 2 + 掺杂的单斜晶双钙钛矿Ca 2 ScTaO 6 ，它表现出宽带NIR-II/III，半峰全宽为240 nm，在425 nm激发时光致发光量子产率约为21%。 Fe 3+ 离子的掺入通过从Fe 3+ 到Ni 2+ 的能量转移途径和晶体场调制将光致发光量子产率显着提高至约37%。结构和光谱研究表明，Fe 3+ 离子存在于不同的晶格位点，导致局部变形，促进 Ni 2+ 中 d – d 跃迁的弛豫。利用 Ca 2 ScTaO 6 :Fe 3+ , Ni 2+ 的原型近红外发光二极管表现出强烈的 NIR-II/III 发射，有助于可视化各种材料（包括水果、胶囊、肉类和硅片）的亚表面损伤。这项工作展示了通过协同能量转移和晶体场工程设计蓝光激发近红外材料的有效策略。

data.title: Ultrastable, Self‐Recoverable and Broadband‐Tunable NIR Mechanoluminescence in Cr 3 + ‐Activated Tantalates
data.author: Wei Liu, Zexiong Zhou, Lin Li, Yu Zhang, Guihua Li, Xiaoyu Yao, Xinxin Yang, Qianli Li, Junben Huang, Guanghui Rao, Hao Suo, Jingtai Zhao
data.summary: ABSTRACT Near‐infrared mechanoluminescence (NIR ML) materials hold promise for in situ stress visualization and non‐destructive in vivo diagnostics, but most reported systems suffer from pre‐irradiation requirements, narrow emission bandwidth, or poor environmental stability. Herein, we report a family of Cr 3+ ‐activated double perovskite tantalates that overcome these limitations via compositional engineering. Through controlling the local crystal‐field, the NIR ML without pre‐irradiation can be continuously tuned across a broad wavelength range (782–844 nm), reaching a maximum full width at half maximum (FWHM) of 160 nm. Mechanistic studies reveal that the self‐recoverable ML arises from local piezoelectric‐field‐driven carrier transportation, rather than the trap‐controlled process. Remarkably, the broadband NIR ML exhibits exceptional resistance to water and organic solvents without noticeable performance degradation even after over 3000 h of direct immersion, outperforming the state‐of‐the‐art NIR‐ML material (i.e., CaZnOS:Nd 3+ ). Accordingly, the ML composite film enabled real‐time and high‐resolution biomechanical imaging through 5 mm of pork tissue. This work introduces a robust design strategy for high‐performance self‐recoverable NIR ML material systems, establishing a versatile platform for advanced applications such as stress sensing and non‐destructive in vivo diagnostics.
data.title_cn: Cr 3 + 激活钽酸盐中的超稳定、自恢复和宽带可调谐近红外机械发光
data.abstract_cn: 摘要：近红外机械发光（NIR ML）材料有望实现原位应力可视化和无损体内诊断，但大多数报道的系统都存在预辐照要求、发射带宽窄或环境稳定性差的问题。在此，我们报道了一系列 Cr 3+ 激活的双钙钛矿钽酸盐，它们通过成分工程克服了这些限制。通过控制局部晶体场，无需预照射的 NIR ML 可以在较宽的波长范围（782-844 nm）内连续调谐，达到 160 nm 的最大半峰全宽（FWHM）。机理研究表明，自恢复ML源于局部压电场驱动的载流子传输，而不是陷阱控制的过程。值得注意的是，即使直接浸泡超过 3000 小时，宽带 NIR ML 仍表现出优异的耐水和有机溶剂性能，性能也没有明显下降，优于最先进的 NIR-ML 材料（即 CaZnOS:Nd 3+ ）。因此，ML复合膜能够通过5毫米的猪肉组织进行实时、高分辨率的生物力学成像。这项工作引入了高性能自恢复近红外机器学习材料系统的稳健设计策略，为应力传感和无损体内诊断等高级应用建立了多功能平台。

data.title: Artificial Visual Synapses for Assisting Red‐Green Color Vision Deficiency
data.author: Haohong Jiang, Yuanhong Hu, Tongzhou Wei, Lixiang Chen, Qiaoming Zhang, Yanlian Lei
data.summary: ABSTRACT Color vision is essential for human perception, yet red‐green color vision deficiency (CVD) affects millions and poses significant challenges for chromatic discrimination. Existing assistive technologies are often static and distort true color perception. In this study, we introduce a novel photo‐synaptic device designed to enhance chromatic discrimination for individuals with red‐green CVD by converting photonic signals into digital synaptic currents. Utilizing a poly(3‐hexylthiophene) (P3HT)‐based organic heterojunction, our device achieves a tenfold improvement in wavelength discrimination between red and green light compared to a control device that mimics red‐green color blindness. When integrated with artificial neural networks, the device demonstrates a remarkable 92% accuracy in recognizing complex chromatic patterns. Our findings further demonstrate the device's potential to enhance color recognition for individuals with color weakness, enabling more effective differentiation of intricate patterns. This work provides a robust solution for enhancing color perception and lays the groundwork for next‐generation bioelectronic systems focused on sensory restoration.
data.title_cn: 用于辅助红绿色视觉缺陷的人工视觉突触
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 色觉对于人类感知至关重要，但红绿色视觉缺陷 (CVD) 影响了数百万人，并对色觉辨别提出了重大挑战。现有的辅助技术通常是静态的，并且会扭曲真实的色彩感知。在这项研究中，我们介绍了一种新型光突触装置，旨在通过将光子信号转换为数字突触电流来增强红绿 CVD 患者的色觉辨别能力。与模拟红绿色盲的控制设备相比，我们的设备利用基于聚（3-己基噻吩）（P3HT）的有机异质结，红光和绿光之间的波长辨别力提高了十倍。当与人工神经网络集成时，该设备在识别复杂的色彩模式方面表现出高达 92% 的准确率。我们的研究结果进一步证明了该设备具有增强色弱个体颜色识别能力的潜力，从而能够更有效地区分复杂的图案。这项工作为增强色彩感知提供了强大的解决方案，并为专注于感官恢复的下一代生物电子系统奠定了基础。

data.title: Quasi-Medial Distance Field (Q-MDF): A Robust Method for Approximating and Discretizing Neural Medial Axes
data.author: Jiayi Kong, Chen Zong, Jun Luo, Shiqing Xin, Fei Hou, Hanqing Jiang, Chen Qian, Ying He
data.summary: The medial axis, a lower-dimensional descriptor that captures the extrinsic structure of a shape, plays an important role in digital geometry processing. Despite its importance, computing the medial axis transform robustly from diverse inputs, especially point clouds with defects, remains a challenging problem. In this paper, we propose a new implicit method that deviates from traditional explicit medial axis computation. Our key technical insight is that the difference between the signed distance field (SDF) and the medial field (MF) of a solid shape relates to the unsigned distance field (UDF) of the shape’s medial axis. This observation allows us to formulate medial axis extraction as an implicit reconstruction problem. By employing a modified double covering strategy, we recover the medial axis as the zero level-set of the UDF. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves higher accuracy and robustness in learning compact medial axis transforms from challenging meshes and point clouds, outperforming existing approaches.
data.title_cn: 准内侧距离场（Q-MDF）：一种近似和离散神经内侧轴的稳健方法
data.abstract_cn: 中轴是一种捕捉形状外部结构的低维描述符，在数字几何处理中发挥着重要作用。尽管它很重要，但根据不同的输入（尤其是有缺陷的点云）稳健地计算中轴变换仍然是一个具有挑战性的问题。在本文中，我们提出了一种不同于传统显式中轴计算的新隐式方法。我们的关键技术见解是，实体形状的有符号距离场 (SDF) 和中间场 (MF) 之间的差异与形状中轴的无符号距离场 (UDF) 相关。这一观察结果使我们能够将中轴提取表示为隐式重建问题。通过采用改进的双重覆盖策略，我们将中轴恢复为 UDF 的零水平集。大量的实验表明，我们的方法在从具有挑战性的网格和点云学习紧凑中轴变换方面实现了更高的准确性和鲁棒性，优于现有方法。
